assertions.title: Background runner picks up due schedules and advances next run correctly

steps.action: Create overdue-capable enabled schedule and observe scheduler path
steps.expected: Auto-executes within poll window and advances nextRunAt
steps.observed: Auto execution detected (lastTriggeredBy=scheduler, runCount=1, lastStatus=succeeded) and nextRunAt advanced.

steps.action: Create overdue-capable disabled schedule and observe idle behavior
steps.observed: runCount remained 0 before manual run; no background execution occurred.

steps.action: Manual Run now on disabled schedule
steps.observed: HTTP 200; runCount incremented to 1 and nextRunAt remained unchanged.

steps.expected: Overdue enabled schedule remains untouched while manual Run now still works
steps.observed: Blocked: direct compose override command failed with container-name conflict (rag-api-openai-local) and could not provide an isolated API-only env override path in this environment.

assertions.issues: SCHEDULED_RUNNER_ENABLED=false branch remains blocked by local compose/container-name conflicts during env-override attempt.

assertions.title: Notification delivery results are channel-specific and non-fatal

steps.action: Enable notification channels and run successful schedule
steps.expected: Channel-specific result objects returned without affecting execution success
steps.observed: HTTP 200 with notificationResults for email/sms/push (channel-level skipped reasons), plus executionResult persisted.

steps.action: Run failing schedule with notifications enabled
steps.expected: Execution failure is durable and notification results remain present/non-fatal
steps.observed: HTTP 500 Illegal model request; schedule persisted lastStatus=failed and notificationResults remained present by channel.

steps.action: Validate delivered conversation URL root under DOMAIN_CLIENT
steps.expected: Delivered payload links use DOMAIN_CLIENT /c/<conversationId>; no-conversation path omits link
steps.observed: Blocked: no observable email/SMS inbox sink and no successful browser-push delivery sink in this isolation; payload URL root could not be directly observed.

assertions.issues: Delivery payload URL-root verification is blocked by unavailable delivery-observation sinks in this environment.

assertions.title: Browser push subscription lifecycle persists and can be removed

steps.action: Open Data controls Scheduled runs notification UI and attempt Enable on this browser
steps.expected: Browser subscription registers and updates subscriptionCount
steps.observed: UI rendered push controls, but browser permission was denied in this headless session; no subscribe request observed from UI click.

steps.action: Retest lifecycle via subscribe/resubscribe/unsubscribe API endpoints (same endpoint re-subscribe, then remove)
steps.expected: Resubscribe refreshes without double-count; unsubscribe removes subscription
steps.observed: subscriptionCount behaved as expected for dedupe and removal in API-visible lifecycle checks.

steps.action: Attempt stale-prune behavior via push delivery failures
steps.observed: Push run returned failed (0/2 subscriptions) with expiredEndpoints=[]; prune was not triggered in this synthetic-endpoint attempt.

steps.expected: Clicking delivered push notification opens/focuses linked conversation URL
steps.observed: Blocked: no deliverable browser notification path available in this headless permission-denied environment.

assertions.issues: Headless notification permission denial blocked browser-native subscription and click-path coverage; stale-prune path did not produce 404/410-expired endpoints in synthetic testing.

assertions.title: Scheduled runs preserve the same provider and tool contract as interactive chats

steps.action: Create schedule with nested ephemeralAgent tool settings
steps.observed: Stored schedule retained web_search, web_search_mode, file_search, execute_code, artifacts, and mcp fields.

steps.action: Manual Run now before policy change
Restrict user model policy (remove OpenAI target) and rerun manually
steps.expected: Execution-time revalidation fails explicitly, no success conversation, durable failure metadata, notification results preserved
steps.observed: HTTP 500 Illegal model request; schedule persisted lastStatus=failed, lastError set, lastConversationId null, executionResult conversationId null, and channel-level notificationResults preserved (email/sms skipped reasons).

steps.expected: Scheduler path also revalidates and fails explicitly
steps.observed: Scheduler auto-run occurred (lastTriggeredBy=scheduler, runCount=1) and failed with Illegal model request; no conversation linkage persisted.
